title: Multitask Mayhem: Unveiling and Mitigating Safety Gaps in LLMs Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM safety guardrails against harmful content including hate speech and cultural stereotypes. It specifically benchmarks the models' handling of religious topics and representation, such as testing prompts that invoke religious stereotypes (e.g., Muslim vs. Jew classification) to determine if models correctly reject them.
